fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatTheBuildUsedToDo: It wrote matter.county into the AcroForm field COUNTY OF, whose widget sits one line above the printed SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT, so the delivered caption read STATE OF NEW MEXICO / COUNTY OF <county> / SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT and named a court the participant has not chosen and cannot file in.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatItDoesNow: Nothing. The county blank on the application caption (delivered page 20) and the county blank on the caption of Form 4-223 bound with it (delivered page 25) are both delivered EMPTY on both fixtures, confirmed by text extraction and by 300 dpi raster. Delivered page 25 is the Form 4-223 caption and is pixel-identical to the base: its county blank was already empty.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.howTheBlankIsDisposed: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING on the application caption, with the ground stated on the row: the county a Sixth District caption asks for is a county of the Sixth Judicial District -- Grant, Hidalgo or Luna -- and the platform holds no such value for a petition filed anywhere else. The order caption's county blank was already required-before-filing and keeps that disposition, with its reason extended to say the same thing.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatTheParticipantIsTold: participant-instructions.md keeps the paragraph telling them to strike the printed district or obtain their own district's copy, and gains one beside it: the caption reads down the page -- state, then county, then court -- so the county line is left empty for them to complete in the same hand and at the same moment as they correct the court line, or to fill in from the start on their district's own copy.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatThisIsNot: It is not a cure for the printed district and not an answer to the statewide-source question. It is the build declining to add its own ink to a caption it cannot make true.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.theStatewideSourceQuestion: The statewide-source question is untouched and stays open: whether the fee-waiver component may ship statewide on binary 809c66a7b7b6d44740e0c91353dc549c041be6245470868a887297ea4d5f623a at all, whose caption prints SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT as page content on a document sworn on oath, or whether it must be conditioned on the Sixth Judicial District the way the retained local order is conditioned on the district that published it. No record under data/record-clearing/ settles it, this lane did not settle it, and leaving the county blank is not an answer to it. The printed district itself is the court's own ink in a pinned binary and is not this lane's to change.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.aJudgmentAVerifierShouldTest: Whether REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING is the right disposition for that county blank is this lane's judgment and not a measurement. The platform holds matter.county and writes it in the caption of every other form in the packet, and the completeness contract allows a required-before-filing blank only where the platform holds no value for the fact. The ground for the disposition is that this blank belongs to the SIXTH Judicial District's caption, and the county such a caption asks for is a county of that district -- Grant, Hidalgo or Luna -- which the platform holds no value for on a petition filed anywhere else, in the same way the district of a pending expungement case is a different fact from the district of this filing. If a verifier rejects that reading, the honest disposition is KNOWN_FACT_NOT_WRITTEN and a counter moves; the row is written so the question can be put rather than hidden. The alternative this lane did not take is writing the county back onto a caption that names the wrong court.

fourTwoTwoDisposition.binary: 809c66a7b7b6d44740e0c91353dc549c041be6245470868a887297ea4d5f623a, the same Form 4-222 NMRA (with Form 4-223 bound at its back) that all three families bind
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatTheBuildUsedToDo: It wrote matter.county into the AcroForm field COUNTY OF, whose widget sits one line above the printed SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT, so the delivered caption read STATE OF NEW MEXICO / COUNTY OF <county> / SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT and named a court the participant has not chosen and cannot file in.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatItDoesNow: Nothing. The county blank on the application caption (delivered page 15) and the county blank on the caption of Form 4-223 bound with it (delivered page 20) are both delivered EMPTY on both fixtures, confirmed by text extraction and by 300 dpi raster. Delivered page 20 is the Form 4-223 caption and is pixel-identical to the base: its county blank was already empty, as VF01 recorded.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.howTheBlankIsDisposed: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING on the application caption, with the ground stated on the row: the county a Sixth District caption asks for is a county of the Sixth Judicial District -- Grant, Hidalgo or Luna -- and the platform holds no such value for a petition filed anywhere else. The order caption's county blank was already required-before-filing and keeps that disposition, with its reason extended to say the same thing.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatTheParticipantIsTold: participant-instructions.md keeps the paragraph telling them to strike the printed district or obtain their own district's copy, and gains one beside it: the caption reads down the page -- state, then county, then court -- so the county line is left empty for them to complete in the same hand and at the same moment as they correct the court line, or to fill in from the start on their district's own copy.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.whatThisIsNot: It is not a cure for the printed district and not an answer to the statewide-source question. It is the build declining to add its own ink to a caption it cannot make true.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.theStatewideSourceQuestion: The statewide-source question is untouched and stays open: whether the fee-waiver component may ship statewide on binary 809c66a7b7b6d44740e0c91353dc549c041be6245470868a887297ea4d5f623a at all, whose caption prints SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT as page content on a document sworn on oath, or whether it must be conditioned on the Sixth Judicial District the way the retained local order is conditioned on the district that published it. No record under data/record-clearing/ settles it, this lane did not settle it, and leaving the county blank is not an answer to it. The printed district itself is the court's own ink in a pinned binary and is not this lane's to change.
fourTwoTwoDisposition.aJudgmentAVerifierShouldTest: Whether REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING is the right disposition for that county blank is this lane's judgment and not a measurement. The platform holds matter.county and writes it in the caption of every other form in the packet, and the completeness contract allows a required-before-filing blank only where the platform holds no value for the fact. The ground for the disposition is that this blank belongs to the SIXTH Judicial District's caption, and the county such a caption asks for is a county of that district -- Grant, Hidalgo or Luna -- which the platform holds no value for on a petition filed anywhere else, in the same way the district of a pending expungement case is a different fact from the district of this filing. If a verifier rejects that reading, the honest disposition is KNOWN_FACT_NOT_WRITTEN and a counter moves; the row is written so the question can be put rather than hidden. The alternative this lane did not take is writing the county back onto a caption that names the wrong court.
